mapper.sql: id, draw_batch_id, division_id, temporary_team_code, temporary_team_name, captain_personal_registration_id, captain_player_id, captain_user_id, expected_member_count, actual_member_count, long_term_team_id, converted_registration_id, formation_status, confirmed_by, confirmed_time, create_time, update_time, is_delete
mapper.select: select from basket_personal_draw_team where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
select from basket_personal_draw_team where draw_batch_id = #{drawBatchId} and is_delete = 0 order by temporary_team_code asc, id asc

select t.id as draw_team_id, t.draw_batch_id, t.division_id, t.temporary_team_code, t.temporary_team_name, t.captain_personal_registration_id, t.captain_player_id, coalesce(p.game_nickname, mp.nickname) as captain_player_name, t.captain_user_id, t.expected_member_count, t.actual_member_count, t.long_term_team_id, lt.team_name as long_term_team_name, t.converted_registration_id, t.formation_status, t.confirmed_time from basket_personal_draw_team t left join basket_player_profile p on p.id = t.captain_player_id and p.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = p.member_id and mp.is_delete = 0 left join basket_team lt on lt.id = t.long_term_team_id and lt.is_delete = 0 where t.draw_batch_id = #{drawBatchId} and t.is_delete = 0 order by t.temporary_team_code asc, t.id asc

select t.id as draw_team_id, t.draw_batch_id, t.division_id, t.temporary_team_code, t.temporary_team_name, t.captain_personal_registration_id, t.captain_player_id, coalesce(p.game_nickname, mp.nickname) as captain_player_name, t.captain_user_id, t.expected_member_count, t.actual_member_count, t.long_term_team_id, lt.team_name as long_term_team_name, t.converted_registration_id, t.formation_status, t.confirmed_time from basket_personal_draw_team t join basket_personal_draw_batch b on b.id = t.draw_batch_id and b.is_delete = 0 and b.batch_status = 'CONFIRMED' left join basket_player_profile p on p.id = t.captain_player_id and p.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = p.member_id and mp.is_delete = 0 left join basket_team lt on lt.id = t.long_term_team_id and lt.is_delete = 0 where t.is_delete = 0 and t.captain_user_id = #{captainUserId} and t.formation_status not in ('CONVERTED', 'CANCELLED') order by t.update_time desc, t.id desc

select t.id as draw_team_id, t.draw_batch_id, t.division_id, t.temporary_team_code, t.temporary_team_name, t.captain_personal_registration_id, t.captain_player_id, coalesce(p.game_nickname, mp.nickname) as captain_player_name, t.captain_user_id, t.expected_member_count, t.actual_member_count, t.long_term_team_id, lt.team_name as long_term_team_name, t.converted_registration_id, t.formation_status, t.confirmed_time from basket_personal_draw_team t left join basket_player_profile p on p.id = t.captain_player_id and p.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = p.member_id and mp.is_delete = 0 left join basket_team lt on lt.id = t.long_term_team_id and lt.is_delete = 0 where t.id = #{drawTeamId} and t.is_delete = 0
mapper.update:
update basket_personal_draw_team
captain_personal_registration_id = #{captainPersonalRegistrationId}, captain_player_id = #{captainPlayerId}, captain_user_id = #{captainUserId}, expected_member_count = #{expectedMemberCount}, actual_member_count = #{actualMemberCount}, long_term_team_id = #{longTermTeamId}, converted_registration_id = #{convertedRegistrationId}, formation_status = #{formationStatus}, confirmed_by = #{confirmedBy}, confirmed_time = #{confirmedTime}, update_time = now()
where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
update basket_personal_draw_team set is_delete = 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0

update basket_personal_draw_team t set t.actual_member_count = ( select count(1) from basket_personal_draw_assignment a where a.draw_team_id = t.id and a.is_delete = 0 ), t.update_time = now() where t.id = #{drawTeamId} and t.is_delete = 0
